title: What the Three-wattled Bellbird sings

is_this_you.pressure: You say one thing, loud and close, and expect the other side to leave the branch.
is_this_you.love: You call from far off first. Up close, you want proof that lasts for years.
is_this_you.cost: Everyone hears you. Hardly anyone knows where you are perched.

opener.text: In rural Honduras one name for this bird is pájaro cafetero, the coffee bird [s6]. In one village its call tells farmers the coffee is ripening [s6]. In another the same call says the allspice is ready, so there it is the allspice bird [s6]. You were born a Gemini in an Ox year. Somebody down the slope has been keeping time by your voice for years.

howto: Three parts. Call one up, and listen for the answer.

tabs.label: Your call
tabs.intro: Air that speaks fast, Earth that keeps its word.

rows.text: Gemini is mutable Air, ruled by Mercury, the messenger [s1]. It is quick, sociable and two-sided [s1] [s2]. The Ox is yin Earth, patient and hardworking, and not good at talking with others [s3] [s4]. So the voice is fast and the promise under it is slow. You say it in a second. You stand behind it for years.

The male's call ranks among the loudest of any bird and carries up to half a mile through cloud forest [s12] [s13] [s16]. Most people learn a bellbird is near only by its call [s12]. People hear about you before they see you. Some never see you at all.

When a rival lands on his perch, the resident male drives him toward the edge, and the intruder is often knocked off the branch [s12]. You keep arguments short. One clear sentence, said at close range. Save it for rivals. It lands too hard on friends.

tabs.label: The song that changes
tabs.intro: Learned by ear, and never quite finished.

rows.text: Bellbirds learn their song by ear [s9] [s10]. Young males spend about six years in subadult plumage working on it [s10]. You practised for years where nobody was listening. You would not sing it out until it could cross the valley.

Donald Kroodsma has followed bellbird dialects since the 1970s [s9]. In one, a whistle slid from about 5,500 Hz to about 3,700 Hz by 2001 [s9]. He says the birds are relearning their songs probably all the time [s9]. Everyone thinks your piece is done. You are still revising it, a little lower each year.

Bellbirds at Monteverde are often bilingual, singing both the Monteverde and Talamanca dialects [s10] [s11]. Gemini has always been the sign of the twins [s1]. You keep a second way of speaking for whoever listens closely.
Voice work, broadcasting and translation suit you. So does a craft with a long apprenticeship, such as building or tuning instruments. In Honduras one of this bird's names is bell tuner [s6].

tabs.label: Who hears you
tabs.intro: Three who answer. One who hears something else.
tabs.love_lead: In love you call from a distance first, then want loyalty up close. You fall for whoever catches the softer dialect under the public call. The old pairings name three who answer.

easy.why: The Fork-tailed Drongo (Gemini, Rooster year) shares your trine of Ox, Snake and Rooster and was born under your sign [s3].
The Satin Bowerbird (Libra, Rooster year) brings the Rooster of your trine, and Libra is Air like Gemini [s3] [s1].
The Meerkat (Gemini, Rat year) is your secret friend, since the Rat is the Ox's hidden ally, and it shares your sign [s3].

hard.why: The hard one is the Bar-headed Goose (Sagittarius, Goat year): the Goat clashes with the Ox, and Sagittarius sits opposite Gemini [s3] [s1].

story.text: In 1992 Costa Rica began the Bellbird Biological Corridor to protect this one species [s7]. It follows the bird's seasonal path, from cloud forest at Monteverde down to the mangroves of the Gulf of Nicoya [s7]. In 2021, for 200 years of independence, the country created the Bicentennial Pájaro Campana Biological Reserve, with this bird as its main conservation target [s8]. A whole landscape was drawn around one call.

closing: Call once from the broken branch. Down the slope, someone is already calling back.
